firmware.note: fox-bench's own firmware for the PicoFox hardware (C, Pico SDK, GPL-3.0-or-later): the fox.json contract and the same templates as the CircuitPython foxes, FM at 8 kHz with pre-emphasis, banner and bench commands on its USB serial console. On air since October 2026 (rev 3 board). Flash it from this card; the vendor firmware goes back the same way.

drive.label: FOXBENCH
drive.note: By default the fox keeps transmitting with the drive mounted and reloads a second after the last write (radio.tx_while_mounted).
